passif.description:
Increases all stats of [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] by [FFAE00]4%[-] and Max HP by [FFAE00]10%[-] for [FFAE00]each[-] one participating in battle.
[i][C0C0C0]※Applicable Allies: Unknown race and [Four Knights of the Apocalypse][-][/i]

The hero gains [00D5FF]Sun's Blessing[-] at the start of the battle.
[i][C0C0C0]※Sun's Blessing: Applicable Allies' damage dealt or taken accumulate up to [FFAE00]300,000[-], inflicting additional damage equal to [FF8000]80%[-] of the accumulated damage when the hero uses a skill.
When fully stacked, the hero gains Light of Judgment for [FFAE00]2 turn(s)[-].
[FFAE00]40%[-] Damage Taken Suppression against single-target attacks (including counters).[-][/i]

[00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] become [00D5FF]immune to stat decrease effects[-], and their final damage taken from enemies decreases by [FF8000]50%[-].

The hero [00D5FF]Fulminates[-] an amount of the enemy's Max HP equal to the damage the hero dealt via the [00D5FF]Brilliance[-] effect.
[i][C0C0C0]※Fulmination: Fulminates up to [FFAE00]50%[-] of Max HP at the start of battle.
When fully stacked, decreases the target's Recovery Rate by [FFAE00]70%[-].
(Max [FFAE00]300,000[-] Fulmination, takes priority over Incineration)[-][/i]

When a [00D5FF][Four Knights of the Apocalypse] ally[-] survives with HP at or below [FFAE00]50%[-], that allied hero is granted [00D5FF]Light of Judgment[-] for [FFAE00]2 turn(s)[-]. [FFAE00](Once)[-]
[i][C0C0C0]※Light of Judgment: All stats [FFAE00]+20%[-], damage dealt [FFAE00]+80%[-].
HP does not fall below [FFAE00]50%[-] (or below its value at the time of application, if already under [FFAE00]50%[-]).[-][/i]

When [00D5FF]Light of Judgment[-] is removed from the hero, or when an [00D5FF]Applicable Ally[-] [00D5FF]uses a Talent[-], the hero gains [00D5FF]Brilliance[-] for [FFAE00]3 turn(s)[-], and upon defeating an enemy, the hero gains [00D5FF]Light of Judgment[-] for [FFAE00]1 turn(s)[-]. (Limit: [FFAE00]1 time(s)[-])
[i][C0C0C0]※Brilliance: Attack-related stats [FFAE00]+50%[-], Crit Chance [FFAE00]+100%[-].[-][/i]

For [FFAE00]each[-] Buff active on the battlefield, [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-]' basic stats increase by [FFAE00]10%[-] and [00D5FF]damage dealt[-] increases by [FF8000]4%[-]. [FFAE00](5 time(s))[-]
